_about: One-time gifts to named characters, given on their next login (src/grants.py). Keys are character names; each part of a gift is given once (editing an entry gives only the parts added or changed). Mounts: the keys in src/mounts.py MOUNT_TEMPLATES. immortal: the name of an account, made an admin (immortal) one only when the character is on it (true is refused: anyone could take a character name). Deckard's true was given before this rule.

xtc.why: the owner testing mounts, riding, the whole map, and the Tunnel of Sticks at endgame strength

deckard.why: the owner's immortal (asked for by name, 2026-10-12); a whole endgame mage kit to see the mage dressed (asked for 2026-10-14)
